body:
My new book released, we had excellent gatherings to discuss the book in New York, Washington DC, and Boston. And in light of religiously-related violence (and puerile filmmaking), there has been a good bit of media attention too.

Today, CNN.com features an op-ed I wrote about Evangelical Islamophobia:

 http://religion.blogs.cnn.com/2012/09/15/my-take-its-time-for-islamophobic-evangelicals-to-choose/?hpt=hp_c1

Yesterday, NPR featured an interview I did with Guy Raz:

 http://www.npr.org/2012/09/15/160610371/embracing-diversity-in-a-multi-faith-world#commentBlock

If you haven’t seen the Read the Spirit interview yet, you’ll find it here:

 http://www.readthespirit.com/explore/2012/9/14/brian-mclaren-on-why-interfaith-peace-begins-at-home.html

A dear friend from DC blogged about the book – and included a candid photo she snapped a year or so ago – here:

 http://melanielynngriffin.wordpress.com

Today, I’m in Jefferson City (capital of Missouri), and tomorrow I’ll be in St. Louis (Ladue). Tuesday I’ll be in Grand Rapids. I hope friends in the Midwest will come say hi! More information available here:

 /archive
